messages:
mira: found a leaked service-account key JSON in a staging GCS archive. spotted via log scrub; not yet seen in prod. looks like partner-integration-sa-key.json. immediate plan: rotate key, revoke the leaked one, and evaluate KMS rewrap vs new key. who can own rotation and partner notification? :eyes:

sam: ack. can take lead on rotation ops. quick q: do we want to rewrap existing secrets with the same KMS key or create a new KMS key and re-encrypt? rewrap is faster but keeps the same KMS key's blast radius.

jonathan: +1 to revoking the leaked key ASAP. steps I'd run: 1) disable/delete the compromised SA key, 2) create a new SA with minimal roles, 3) issue short-lived creds via workload identity (if app supports), 4) update Vault entries and TF, 5) trigger CI e2e to validate. prefer new KMS key for partner-facing credentials if we suspect the key material was exfiltrated.

alex: do we know which apps read the archived logs? might be staging-only but double-check backups and artifact stores. also we should rotate any Vault wrapped values that used the SA for encryption or signing.

mira: confirmed staging-only for now. partner webhook uses that SA for uploading artifacts. partner contact is on call but possibly out; I can message them after we have a safe rollout plan.

sam: here's the commands I plan to run (testing in a sandbox first):
```
# disable key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-integration@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=partner-integration@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# rotate TF/ Vault - example for Vault transit rewrap
vault write transit/keys/partner-integration-child rewrap=true
```

jonathan: add RBAC tightening to that list. the SA had roles: roles/storage.admin + roles/pubsub.admin. let's replace with granular roles: storage.objectAdmin for the specific bucket and pubsub.publisher on the targeted topic. open a TF PR to do that and run a plan.

ops-oncall: putting a short hold on any deploys that touch partner staging until rotation completes. :lock:

mira: I'll DM the partner after rotation plan is ready. also: audit requirements — we need to log the key disable event, Vault access, and any KMS rewrap operations to the compliance log. vault-bot: please tag related audit entries to INC-2026.

vault-bot: automated: created audit tag INC-2026 for vault/transit and auth backends.

sam: timeline: sandbox test within 30m, rotate in staging in 60-90m, notify partner and confirm ingestion, then push RBAC TF PR. if partner accepts, we can promote to prod next maintenance window.

jonathan: I'll review the TF PR and prep a short rollback plan (re-add old SA with no key if needed) and a runbook note about re-enabling services. Also suggest we rotate any KMS wrapping keys used for backups that might have referenced the SA.

mira: action items: sam = run rotation; jonathan = TF RBAC PR & rollback plan; alex = scan backups + artifact stores for key exposure; mira = partner contact + compliance note. ops-oncall = hold deploys. I'll update here when rotation is complete. :thumbsup:

sam: starting sandbox test now. will post results in this thread.

alex: scanning artifact stores now. found 2 archived blobs referencing the key name in a commit message — marking for cleanup.

mira: thanks. if anything else pops up ping me.

sam: sandbox test passed, rotation script looks good. proceeding to staging rotate in ~10m and will paste output here.

sam: staging rotate done. disabled old key, created new key, updated Vault entries, and triggered canary. app canaries passed. leaving note: re-encrypt jobs for backup buckets queued.

mira: partner notified and acknowledged. they will validate from their side and rotate any cached credentials. filing INC-2026 followups and adding runbook link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/secret-rotation.

jonathan: PR opened for RBAC tightening and TF plan looks good. assigning to ops for apply after 2h cooling.

ops-oncall: will keep deploys on hold for 2h. please tag me when ready to unhold.

mira: excellent work team. postmortem & lessons: avoid storing key JSONs in archived logs, add a logging scrubbing filter, and require workload identity for partner integrations. I'll start a ticket for the scrubbing filter. :memo:
